facts.text: The President's Promise Scholarship covers 100% of remaining tuition costs for up to four years for new freshmen and two years for new transfer students.

sources.title: The President's Promise Scholarship - East Texas A&M University
sources.quote: The scholarship covers all tuition not covered by other grants or scholarships. It will meet 100% of the student's tuition costs for up to four years for new freshmen or up to two years for new transfer students.
